tissue_state_grouping.caveat: The lift over the raw modalities stands - 5.4x over raw ST (0.046 -> 0.246), 1.5x over raw H&E (0.164). That is not in dispute and the report's 'supported after correction' verdict holds. What this metric cannot do on this cohort is RANK the aligned methods against each other. Three independent signals: NMI(mc_megacluster, patient_id) = 0.539, above the 0.5 confounder bar this project applies elsewhere - the label is part patient identity. The linear probe moves 1.2 points (0.270 -> 0.282) against a 0.216 majority-class floor - the lift is geometric, not informational; alignment reshaped the manifold so KMeans could find what was already there. And the 200x patient-bootstrap intervals overlap for 8 of the 9 adjudicated methods (B1 excluded as contraindicated) - only cross-attention falls outside, as the lowest. Same species as the 9 spatial archetypes at NMI 0.89 that forced the label change: one confounder bar down, not cleared.

gpath2vec.why_not_R4: R4 differs from R6 in TWO things, the pathway input and the fusion mode, so R6 against R4 cannot attribute an effect to either. the matched comparison is R1 against R6: same loss, same late fusion, same H&E input, differing only in gpath2vec.
